<Heading as={"h1"} className={"openapi__heading"}>
  {"Get decision definition"} <MarkerAddedInVersion version="8.8" />{" "}
  <MarkerScope scope="physical-tenant" />
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/decision-definitions/{decisionDefinitionKey}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

<MarkerEventuallyConsistentExtension />

Returns a decision definition by key.

<MarkerRequiredPermissions
  permissions={[
    {
      resourceType: "DECISION_DEFINITION",
      permissionType: "READ_DECISION_DEFINITION",
    },
  ]}
/>

<Heading id={"request"} as={"h2"} className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[
    {
      name: "decisionDefinitionKey",
      in: "path",
      required: true,
      description:
        "The assigned key of the decision definition, which acts as a unique identifier for this decision.",
      schema: {
        type: "string",
        format: "string<DecisionDefinitionKey>",
        example: "2251799813326547",
        description: "System-generated key for a decision definition.",
      },
    },
  ]}
></ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema title={"Body"} body={undefined}></RequestSchema>
